memory_verse: "He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit." —Romans 8:11, NASB
sermon_title: A Freedom Only Christ Can Give

days.focus: External vs. Internal: What God Really Sees
days.application: Write down one area of your inner life that looks fine externally but that you know God sees differently. Bring it honestly before Him in prayer today.

days.focus: The Dirty Cup: Confronting What's Inside
days.application: Ask a trusted, honest question: 'If someone could see every thought and motive I had this week, what would they find?' Write one specific thing you want God to cleanse from the inside of your cup.

days.focus: Jesus Came to Set Captives Free
days.application: Identify one recurring sin or inner bondage you have been carrying. Spend ten minutes in prayer specifically asking Christ — not willpower or routine — to bring release to that captivity.

days.focus: Do You Wish to Be Well? Choosing Freedom Over Settling
days.application: Answer Jesus' question honestly in writing: 'Do I truly wish to be well in this area, or have I quietly settled for my condition?' Commit your answer to God and memorize the first half of Romans 8:11 today.

days.focus: Freedom the Law Cannot Give: The Gospel for Sinners
days.application: Re-read Acts 13:39 alongside the memory verse Romans 8:11. Write one sentence in your own words connecting what Christ frees us from (Acts 13:39) with the power He uses to do it (Romans 8:11), then recite the full memory verse aloud three times.

days.focus: Living for God's Opinion: A Heart That Pleases Him in Secret
days.application: Use Psalm 51 as a personal prayer, inserting your own specific inner struggles. Then write out Romans 8:11 from memory, without looking, and place it somewhere visible for the Sunday service tomorrow as a reminder of the freedom only Christ can give.
